settings.heading: Before you book
settings.text: Anything else? Send me a message and I will answer within a working day.

settings.question: Who do you work with?
settings.answer: People in their first few years of managing others: team leads, new heads of a function and founders hiring their first team. Most of my clients lead between three and twenty people.

settings.question: What happens on the free call?
settings.answer: Twenty minutes on video. You tell me about your team and what is hard right now, I ask a few questions, and I say honestly whether I can help. There is no pitch at the end.

settings.question: Can my company pay for it?
settings.answer: Often, yes. Many clients use a training or development budget. You get an invoice in the company's name, and I can send a short outline for your manager.

settings.question: How long do clients usually stay?
settings.answer: Most stay four to six months on monthly coaching. You can stop or pause any month, with no notice period.

settings.question: Is what I say kept private?
settings.answer: Yes. When a company pays, I share only that we are meeting, never what we talk about.

settings.question: What if it is not working?
settings.answer: Tell me. If after the first month you feel it is not worth it, I refund that month.
